name: TemplateBrowser
title: Templates/Platform/View/TemplateBrowser
summary: The template catalog people start a project from: a medium page heading with the outlined Documentation action, one `PropertyFilter` that searches the name and the description and filters by Category and Framework, then one section per category (Frameworks, Starters, Functions) with a grid of template tiles. Each tile is a `Card` with the framework mark, the name as a button that opens the preview, two lines of description and the framework `Tag`; the whole tile is the target. The preview is a medium right `Drawer`: the mark and the name in the header, the description, a `KeyValuePairs` of framework, category, repository and last update, and the template's README in a `Card` through `DocProse`; its footer holds View repository and the primary Deploy, which leads to the deploy template flow (`platform/create/deploy-template`), where the deploy runs and reports by toast. The filter lives in the URL through `useCollection`. A search that matches nothing shows No matching templates with Clear filters; while the catalog loads the tiles are skeletons; a catalog that fails to load shows a danger `Alert` with Retry and an Import from Git way out. Built from `PageHeader`, `Button`, `PropertyFilter`, `Card`, `Tag`, `EmptyState`, `Drawer`, `DrawerPortal`, `DrawerOverlay`, `DrawerContent`, `DrawerTitle`, `DrawerClose`, `PanelHeader`, `PanelContent`, `PanelFooter`, `KeyValuePairs` and `DocProse`.

variants.name: Preview
variants.summary: The preview drawer open on Next.js Starter: details, the README and the Deploy entry into the deploy template flow.

variants.name: NoMatch
variants.summary: A search that matches no template: the filter keeps the token and a medium EmptyState offers Clear filters.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The catalog is loading: the filter is disabled and two sections of skeleton tiles hold the layout.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The catalog failed to load: a danger Alert with Retry, and an EmptyState that points to Import from Git.
